Ava: Kicking off deploy window at 18:30 UTC — small release (routing + cache tweaks). Plan: 10m ramp, validation probes, then progressive rollout. Who's owning rollback if needed? :eyes:
Sam: I'm on rollback owner. Will stand by 18:20-18:50.
Priya: I'll run the health checks and perf probes once canary is up.
Luca: CI is green, canary image pushed -> `gcr.io/redwood/release-20260318-abc123`.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started on cluster-redwood-canary (id c-42).
Maya: Quick readiness list: 1) feature flags toggled 2) no DB migrations 3) alerts & runbook linked (https://go/runbooks/deploy-3798765432) — on-call pinged.
Ava: Rollback steps (short): `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/realtime-api` then trigger pipeline job `infra/rollback-deploy --tag canary` — Sam, you good to execute?
Sam: Yep, rollback job prepped and I have deploy permissions.
Priya: Smoke commands I'll run: `curl -sS https://canary.redwood.ai/health | jq .status` then a light load probe: \`hey -z 30s -c 5 https://canary.redwood.ai/predict\`. Will post results.
Luca: Observability: dashboard updated, tracing tag `deploy:3798765432`, and synthetic probe scheduled for 2m intervals.
Ava: Approvals: @product and @security signed off earlier. Final go: please reply with :+1: in this thread.
Maya: :+1: ready to monitor.
Sam: :+1: rollback ready.
Priya: :+1: smoke checks ready.
Luca: :+1: telemetry good.
Ava: Launching canary in 2m. I'll post status updates here.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed. Instances healthy: 3/3.
Priya: Health OK, 95th p99 latency ~110ms, error rate steady at 0.02%. No traces of alpha regressions.
Ava: Moving to 30% after a 10m observation window. If errors exceed 0.5% or latency >200ms, Sam will roll back.
Sam: Noted — standing by for rollback if errors >0.5% or alert fires.
Ava: Thanks all — will update after the ramp. :rocket:
